Communities of a hypergraph or a memory network

Source: R/dispatch.R
hg_communities.Rd

One verb, two estimators, chosen by the class of x:

a hypergraph (net_hg)

an ensemble of Infomap runs on a projection (or IRMM with type = "irmm"), with the adjusted-mutual- information medoid; see hg_communities.net_hg().

a memory network (net_hon, from hon())

the map equation for memory networks: overlapping modules of the physical states, compared with the first-order map; see hg_communities.net_hon().

Each method keeps its own arguments; passing an argument that only the other method takes raises hypernets_bad_input.

Usage

hg_communities(x, ...)

# Default S3 method
hg_communities(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A net_hg or a net_hon.

...

Arguments of the method for class(x).

Value

An hg_communities object (hypergraph) or a net_hon_communities object (memory network); read either with hg_get(). Any other input raises hypernets_bad_input.

Examples

seqs <- list(c("a", "h", "b", "a", "h", "b", "a"),
             c("c", "h", "d", "c", "h", "d", "c"))
comm <- hg_communities(hon(seqs, max_order = 2L), trials = 2L)
hg_get(comm)
#>   node state community      flow
#> 1    a     a         1 0.1669582
#> 2    b     b         1 0.1611273
#> 3    c     c         1 0.1669582
#> 4    d     d         1 0.1611273
#> 5    h     h         1 0.3438290
